title: Eligibility Traces for Confounding Robust Off-Policy Evaluation: A Causal Approach

contributions.purpose: 在离线数据可能存在未观测混杂(unobserved confounding)且行为策略与目标策略无公共支撑(no-overlap)、导致值函数不可识别时,推导出对目标值函数稳健的闭式界
contributions.mechanism: 扩展 Bellman 方程,从未知行为策略生成的观测分布中推导出对目标值函数的最优(sharp)闭式上下界(Thm 1/2);界基于偏识别/因果推断,不需系统动力学的额外参数化知识
contributions.evaluation: 定性:在 Windy Gridworld(Gymnasium 实现)中所得界与真值状态/状态-动作值函数一致(Fig 2);因观测约束紧,界是 sharp 的、无额外假设不可再改进
contributions.domain: 强化学习 / 离策略评估 / 因果推断
contributions.source_quote: (1) We extend the Bellman equation that permits one to derive optimal bounds over target value functionsfrom the observational distribution generated by an unknown behavior policy.

contributions.purpose: 从有限的、含未观测混杂与 no-overlap 的观测数据中,估计对状态值函数的界
contributions.mechanism: 提出因果离策略时序差分算法 C-TD(λ),用 eligibility traces 估计界;model-free;Thm 3 证明离线更新以概率 1 收敛到上下界
contributions.evaluation: 定性:Windy Gridworld 两组实验(混杂行为策略/确定性次优策略违反 overlap)中一致得到 informative bounds;标准离策略方法明显偏离目标效应
contributions.domain: 强化学习 / 离策略评估
contributions.source_quote: (2) We propose a causal off-policy temporal difference algorithm $C-TD(λ)$ ) using eligibility traces to estimate bounds over the state value function from finite observations contaminated with unobserved confounding and no-overlap.

contributions.purpose: 作为 C-TD 的替代,从混杂观测中获得对状态-动作值函数(Q)的界
contributions.mechanism: 提出基于 tree backup 的因果 eligibility traces 算法 C-TB(λ);eligibility traces 除用目标策略加权外还乘指示函数 1[x_{t-1}=x];Thm 4 证明以概率 1 收敛到 Q 的上下界
contributions.evaluation: 定性:Windy Gridworld Experiment 2(确定性次优行为策略,顶半区违反 overlap)中 C-TB(λ) 一致得到 informative bounds,与真值(Fig 5m)一致;标准方法不稳健
contributions.domain: 强化学习 / 离策略评估
contributions.source_quote: (3)We introduce an alternative eligibility traces algorithm following tree backup $C-TB(λ)$ ) that obtains bounds over the state-action value function from confounded observations.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our wvork differs from robust RL methods since it does not require a pre-specified uncertainty set of model parameters. Instead, we construct the ignorance region over the underlying system dynamics from the confounded observational data using partial causal identification.

To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work that develops off-policy algorithms using eligibility traces to obtain evaluations of candidate policies from biased offline data, possibly contaminated with unmeasured confounding or no-overlap,with provable guarantees on the convergence of learned evaluations.

notes: 纯理论/仿真论文(ICLR 2025 reject)。无定量指标(MSE 等),全部为定性结论:所提算法在合成 Windy Gridworld 中一致得到与真值一致的 informative bounds,并有以概率 1 收敛的可证明保证(Thm 3/4,基于 Jaakkola et al. 1994 收敛定理)。对比性负结果针对 baseline 而非本方法:标准离策略方法在混杂/无 overlap 下不稳健、显著偏离目标效应。方法自身宣称的优势是 model-free、不依赖系统动力学的额外参数化知识、不需预设参数不确定集。所有实验均为合成,未引入新数据资产。
